description: Image Description: The image shows a blue traffic sign mounted on the side of a building. The sign has a white border and features three symbols in white. On the left, there is a silhouette of an adult walking, representing a pedestrian. In the middle, there is a silhouette of a child playing with a ball, indicating a play area or caution for children. On the right, there is a car icon suggesting vehicle presence or access. Above these symbols, there is a house with a curved road
